summary: node1 now serves HTTPS on port 8443 using nginx. A systemd timer checks every 12 hours and renews the locally generated 30-day certificate when fewer than 7 days remain. nginx gracefully reloads each renewed certificate without interrupting requests. Configuration and certificate persisted across a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Configured HTTPS on TCP/8443 and opened the firewalld port.
Created an atomic certificate-renewal script with a seven-day renewal threshold.
Created and enabled a persistent systemd renewal timer.
Proved live certificate rotation with 100 uninterrupted requests.
Restarted node1 and verified its changed boot identity and complete recovery.

evidence.summary: nginx listens on port 8443; the final trusted HTTPS request succeeds and nginx is active.

evidence.requirement: Automatically renew the certificate before expiration
evidence.summary: The timer is enabled and active. A certificate inside the seven-day renewal window was replaced through the normal systemd service with a new 30-day certificate; the final threshold check confirms renewal is not currently needed.

evidence.requirement: Pick up renewed certificates while continuing to answer requests
evidence.summary: Both forced and threshold-driven rotations changed the served serial while preserving nginx's master PID; each test completed 100 requests with zero failures.

Captured healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement, observed boot ID change from 4d340bf4-0579-47f0-98c1-5c17a66d50f1 to ebfb0d42-d311-4d78-ae3d-4e2cd2875f8b, then verified nginx, HTTPS response, certificate, firewall rule, and renewal timer recovered.
